name: Declared Summary Attempt Routes
description: C06/C11 declared attempt-route demo: TypeScript, Rust, Solidity and optional Go produce routes run as declared attempts and emit versioned lineage — exited runs select captured stdout only when declared inputs are unchanged, and a timed-out attempt selects nothing.

harness_contract.intent: Demonstrate the declared *-summaries-attempt routes end to end: run TypeScript, Rust and Solidity plus Go when its optional helper can be built, observe exited runs select captured stdout, and show a timed-out attempt selecting no result.
artifact_contracts: Read inputs: the demo_counter fixtures in scenarios/ts_summaries, scenarios/rust_summaries, scenarios/sol_summaries and scenarios/go_summaries plus the sibling mumei-agent *-summaries-attempt route commands.
The Go types helper build is optional; only the Go helper and Go attempt steps are skipped when Go is unavailable. The TypeScript, Rust and Solidity attempts do not depend on Go.

Generate evidence: ts_attempt.log, rust_attempt.log, sol_attempt.log, build_go_types.log, go_attempt.log, timeout_refusal.log, ts_attempt.json, rust_attempt.json, sol_attempt.json, go_attempt.json, go_attempt.stderr, timeout_attempt.json, bin/go-types when Go is available, harness_state.json, result.json, and report.md.

Gate order: TypeScript, Rust and Solidity attempts run independently of Go; the optional Go helper and attempt run before the timeout refusal, which asserts only the reported outcome — a refusal emits the report at exit 0 with no candidate.
Every report is canonical lineage, not an accepted manifest: the candidate descriptor binds the selected output by fingerprint only.
notes: The analyzers are source-analysis infrastructure, not verifiers; the demo routes them only through the declared *-summaries-attempt lifecycle.
Every attempt runs the real route command. TypeScript, Rust and Solidity need no provisioned toolchain; Go uses the optional go-types helper build, and only Go steps skip when Go is unavailable.
The Go attempt report must use mumei.go-summaries-attempt-report/v1, show outcome exited and exit_code 0, include sequence.selected_result, and preserve the source and helper bytes.
The timeout step uses --attempt-timeout 1 so the observed run cannot finish inside the bound; the report still exits 0 and asserts outcome timed_out with no candidate key.
budget_policy_fingerprint is summaries-attempt-v1 for deterministic runs.

steps.name: Attempt: ts-summaries produce route under the C11 lifecycle
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent ts-summaries-attempt {root_dir}/scenarios/ts_summaries/demo_counter.ts --attempt-timeout 30000 > {output_dir}/ts_attempt.json 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/ts_attempt.json; test $rc -eq 0 && grep -q '"outcome": "exited"' {output_dir}/ts_attempt.json && grep -q '"exit_code": 0' {output_dir}/ts_attempt.json && grep -q '"candidate"' {output_dir}/ts_attempt.json
steps.artifact_contract: ts_attempt step must write {output_dir}/ts_attempt.json holding the mumei.ts-summaries-attempt-report/v1 report with an exited outcome, exit_code 0 and a selected candidate.
steps.verifier_gate: ts-summaries-attempt exits 0 (checked via rc after redirecting output so the pipe cannot mask it) and the greps require outcome exited, exit_code 0 and a candidate key, so a failed or unselected run fails the step instead of passing.

steps.name: Attempt: rust-summaries produce route under the C11 lifecycle
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent rust-summaries-attempt {root_dir}/scenarios/rust_summaries/demo_counter.rs --attempt-timeout 30000 > {output_dir}/rust_attempt.json 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/rust_attempt.json; test $rc -eq 0 && grep -q '"outcome": "exited"' {output_dir}/rust_attempt.json && grep -q '"exit_code": 0' {output_dir}/rust_attempt.json && grep -q '"candidate"' {output_dir}/rust_attempt.json
steps.artifact_contract: rust_attempt step must write {output_dir}/rust_attempt.json holding the mumei.rust-summaries-attempt-report/v1 report with an exited outcome, exit_code 0 and a selected candidate.
steps.verifier_gate: rust-summaries-attempt exits 0 (checked via rc) and the greps require outcome exited, exit_code 0 and a candidate key, so a failed or unselected run fails the step instead of passing.

steps.name: Attempt: sol-summaries produce route under the C11 lifecycle
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent sol-summaries-attempt {root_dir}/scenarios/sol_summaries/demo_counter.sol --attempt-timeout 30000 > {output_dir}/sol_attempt.json 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/sol_attempt.json; test $rc -eq 0 && grep -q '"outcome": "exited"' {output_dir}/sol_attempt.json && grep -q '"exit_code": 0' {output_dir}/sol_attempt.json && grep -q '"candidate"' {output_dir}/sol_attempt.json
steps.artifact_contract: sol_attempt step must write {output_dir}/sol_attempt.json holding the mumei.sol-summaries-attempt-report/v1 report with an exited outcome, exit_code 0 and a selected candidate.
steps.verifier_gate: sol-summaries-attempt exits 0 (checked via rc) and the greps require outcome exited, exit_code 0 and a candidate key, so a failed or unselected run fails the step instead of passing.

steps.name: Provision: build the optional Go summary helper
steps.command: mkdir -p {output_dir}/bin && cd {mumei_agent_repo}/tools/go-types && GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off GOWORK=off go build -o {output_dir}/bin/go-types . && echo 'go-types helper built'
steps.artifact_contract: Build the go-types helper into {output_dir}/bin/go-types when Go is available; otherwise this optional step and the dependent Go attempt are skipped.
steps.verifier_gate: The provisioned helper is available to the Go attempt route; this step does not gate TypeScript, Rust or Solidity.

steps.name: Attempt: Go summaries produce route under the C11 lifecycle
steps.command: before=$(sha256sum {root_dir}/scenarios/go_summaries/demo_counter.go {output_dir}/bin/go-types) && {mumei_agent_python} -m agent go-summaries-attempt --source {root_dir}/scenarios/go_summaries/demo_counter.go --go-types {output_dir}/bin/go-types --attempt-timeout 30000 --timeout 30 > {output_dir}/go_attempt.json 2> {output_dir}/go_attempt.stderr; rc=$?; after=$(sha256sum {root_dir}/scenarios/go_summaries/demo_counter.go {output_dir}/bin/go-types); cat {output_dir}/go_attempt.json; cat {output_dir}/go_attempt.stderr; test $rc -eq 0 && test "$before" = "$after" && {mumei_agent_python} -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); assert r["schema_version"] == "mumei.go-summaries-attempt-report/v1"; n=r["normalized"]; assert n["outcome"] == "exited" and n["exit_code"] == 0; assert r["sequence"]["selected_result"] is not None; print("Go source and helper bytes unchanged")' {output_dir}/go_attempt.json
expected_patterns: Go source and helper bytes unchanged
steps.artifact_contract: go_attempt.json must hold mumei.go-summaries-attempt-report/v1 with outcome exited, exit_code 0 and a non-null sequence.selected_result; the source and helper bytes must match before and after the route.
steps.verifier_gate: go-summaries-attempt exits 0, reports the pinned schema and selected result, and source/helper hashes match before and after the run.

steps.name: Refusal: a timed-out attempt selects no result
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent ts-summaries-attempt {root_dir}/scenarios/ts_summaries/demo_counter.ts --attempt-timeout 1 > {output_dir}/timeout_attempt.json 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/timeout_attempt.json; test $rc -eq 0 && grep -q '"outcome": "timed_out"' {output_dir}/timeout_attempt.json && ! grep -q '"candidate"' {output_dir}/timeout_attempt.json
steps.artifact_contract: timeout_refusal step must write {output_dir}/timeout_attempt.json holding the report with outcome timed_out and no candidate key — a refused attempt claims nothing.
steps.verifier_gate: ts-summaries-attempt exits 0 (the report is lineage, not failure) and the greps require outcome timed_out plus the absence of a candidate key, so a run that still selected output fails the step instead of passing.

narrative.moment: Declared attempt lineage only; exited routes select output and timeout selects none.
intro: Step 1: ts-summaries-attempt runs the TypeScript produce route as one declared attempt...
Step 2: rust-summaries-attempt runs the Rust produce route the same way...
Step 3: sol-summaries-attempt runs the Solidity produce route the same way...
Step 4: when Go is available, the optional helper is built and go-summaries-attempt selects the unchanged source analysis output...
Step 5: a 1ms-bound attempt times out and selects nothing — the report still exits 0 as lineage, claiming no result.
narrative.before: No declared attempt lineage exists for the TypeScript, Rust, Solidity and Go summary produce routes; nothing records which observed run produced a manifest.
narrative.after: The TypeScript, Rust and Solidity reports, plus go_attempt.json when Go is available, record exited runs whose captured stdout was selected into candidate descriptors; timeout_attempt.json records a timed-out run that selected nothing.

follow_up: schema_version mumei.ts-summaries-attempt-report/v1 pins the report shape.
The attempt sequence binds the request fingerprint to the declared source bytes.
outcome exited + exit_code 0 means the observed run completed; the candidate binds the selected stdout by fingerprint.
Step 2: Running the Rust produce route as a declared attempt...

pass.headline: rust-summaries-attempt: exited run selected
follow_up: The same lifecycle: request fingerprint, dispatch observation, drift gate, publication.
candidate present only because the exited run's declared input bytes were unchanged.
Step 3: Running the Solidity produce route as a declared attempt...

pass.headline: sol-summaries-attempt: exited run selected
follow_up: Three languages, one lineage shape — canonical, never an accepted manifest.
Step 4: Running the optional Go produce route when its helper is available...

pass.headline: go-summaries-attempt: exited run selected
follow_up: The Go route reports mumei.go-summaries-attempt-report/v1 with outcome exited and exit_code 0.
sequence.selected_result is present, and source/helper bytes match before and after the attempt.
This optional step is skipped when Go is absent; the TypeScript, Rust and Solidity steps are independent.

pass.headline: Timed-out attempt selects no result
follow_up: outcome timed_out at the 1ms bound — the observed run never finished.
No candidate key: a refused attempt claims nothing.
Demo complete: declared attempt lineage recorded for available produce routes.
